title.zh: 卷二十九 志第十九 曆五
title.raw: 卷二十九 志第十九 曆五 Volume 29 Treatises 22: Calendar 5

sentences.zh: 寶應元年六月望戊夜，月蝕三之一。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoying, on the night of the fifteenth of the sixth month, day wu, the moon was eclipsed by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: On the full-moon night of the sixth month in the first year of Baoying (day wu), the moon suffered a partial eclipse of one-third.

sentences.zh: 官曆加時在日出後，有交，不署蝕。

translations.literal: The official calendar's hour-addition fell after sunrise; though there was a crossing, no eclipse was entered.
translations.idiomatic: According to the official calendar, the computed hour fell after sunrise; although a conjunction occurred, no eclipse was recorded.

sentences.zh: 代宗以《至德曆》不與天合，詔司天臺官屬郭獻之等，復用《麟德》元紀，更立歲差，增損遲疾、交會及五星差數，以寫《大衍》舊術。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong, because the Zhide Calendar did not accord with Heaven, ordered the Astronomical Bureau officials Guo Xianzhi and others to restore the Lindé era constant, establish anew precession, and adjust slow/fast, syzygies, and five-planet differentials, copying the old Dayan methods.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Zhide Calendar did not match the heavens, Emperor Daizong ordered Guo Xianzhi and other officials of the Directorate of Astronomy to revive the Lindé era epoch, set precession anew, and adjust the parameters for lunar anomaly, syzygies, and the five planets, following the old Dayan procedures.

sentences.zh: 上元七曜，起赤道虛四度。

translations.literal: At the high origin the seven luminaries begin at four degrees into Xū on the equator.
translations.idiomatic: At the high origin, the seven luminaries start at 4° of Xū on the celestial equator.

sentences.zh: 帝為制序，題曰《五紀曆》。

translations.literal: The emperor composed a preface and titled it the Wuji Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote a preface and named the work the Wuji Calendar.

sentences.zh: 其與《大衍》小異者九事，曰：仲夏之朔，若月行極疾，合於亥正，朔不進，則朔之晨，月見東方矣。

translations.literal: Its nine points of slight difference from the Dayan are as follows: At the new moon of midsummer, if the moon's motion is extremely fast and meets the hai hour exactly, the new moon does not advance—then on the morning of the new moon the moon is seen in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Nine points on which it differs slightly from the Dayan: At the midsummer new moon, if the moon moves at its fastest and the conjunction falls exactly at the hai hour so that the new moon does not advance, the moon will be visible in the east on the morning of the new moon.

sentences.zh: 依《大衍》，戌初進初朔，則朔之夕，月見西方矣。

translations.literal: According to the Dayan, advancing the first new moon at the start of xu, then on the evening of the new moon the moon is seen in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Dayan, if the first new moon is advanced to the start of the xu double-hour, the moon appears in the west on the evening of the new moon.

sentences.zh: 當視定朔小餘不滿《五紀》通法，如晨初餘數減十刻已下者，進以明日為朔。

translations.literal: One should regard the fixed new moon's minor remainder: when it does not fill the Wuji universal divisor, if the dawn-initial remainder number is reduced by ten quarter-hours or less, advance and take the next day as the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed new moon's minor remainder falls short of the Wuji universal divisor, and the dawn-initial remainder would be reduced by ten quarter-hours or less, advance the new moon to the following day.

sentences.zh: 一也。

translations.literal: This is the first.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first point.

sentences.zh: 以三萬二千一百六十乘夜半定漏刻，六十七乘刻分從之，二千四百而一，為晨初餘數。

translations.literal: Multiply the midnight fixed clepsydra quarter-hours by 32,160; let 67 times the quarter-hour parts follow; divide by 2,400 to obtain the dawn-initial remainder number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the midnight fixed clepsydra quarters by 32,160, add 67 times the fractional quarters, divide by 2,400, and obtain the dawn-initial remainder.

sentences.zh: 二也。

translations.literal: This is the second.
translations.idiomatic: This is the second point.

sentences.zh: 陽曆去交分，交前加一辰，交後減一辰，餘百八十三已下者，日亦蝕。

translations.literal: For the yang calendar's distance from conjunction parts: before conjunction add one double-hour, after conjunction subtract one double-hour; if the remainder is 183 or below, there is also a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: For solar-eclipse distance from conjunction: add one double-hour before conjunction and subtract one after; if the remainder is 183 or less, a solar eclipse also occurs.

sentences.zh: 三也。

translations.literal: This is the third.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third point.

sentences.zh: 月蝕有差，以望日所入定數，視月道同名者，交前為加，交後為減；

translations.literal: Lunar eclipses have discrepancy: using the fixed number entered on the full-moon day, where the moon's path shares the same name, before conjunction is add and after conjunction is subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipses require correction: take the fixed entry for full moon; when the lunar path shares the same designation, add before conjunction and subtract after;

sentences.zh: 異名者，交前為減，交後為加，各以加減去交分。

translations.literal: where the names differ, before conjunction is subtract and after conjunction is add; in each case add or subtract from the distance-from-conjunction parts.
translations.idiomatic: when the designations differ, subtract before conjunction and add after, each time adjusting the distance from conjunction.

sentences.zh: 又交前減一辰，交後加一辰，餘如三百三十八已下者，既。

translations.literal: Further, before conjunction subtract one double-hour, after conjunction add one double-hour; if the remainder is like 338 or below, it is total.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract one double-hour before conjunction and add one after; if the remainder is 338 or less, the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 已上，以減望差，八十約之，得蝕分。

translations.literal: If above that, subtract from the full-moon difference, reduce by 80, and obtain the eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: If greater, subtract from the full-moon difference, divide by 80, and obtain the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 四也。

translations.literal: This is the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth point.

sentences.zh: 日蝕有差，以朔日所入定數，十五而一，以減百四，餘為定法。

translations.literal: Solar eclipses have discrepancy: using the fixed number entered on the new-moon day, divide by fifteen, subtract from 104; the remainder is the fixed method.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipses require correction: take the fixed entry for new moon, divide by fifteen, subtract from 104, and the remainder is the fixed divisor.

sentences.zh: 以蝕差減去交分。

translations.literal: Subtract the eclipse discrepancy from the distance-from-conjunction parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the eclipse correction from the distance from conjunction.

sentences.zh: 又交前減兩辰，餘為陰曆蝕。

translations.literal: Further, before conjunction subtract two double-hours; the remainder is a yin-calendar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract two double-hours before conjunction; the remainder indicates a yin-half solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其不足減者，反減蝕差。

translations.literal: If it is insufficient to subtract, inversely subtract the eclipse discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction is insufficient, subtract the eclipse correction in reverse.

sentences.zh: 在交後減兩辰，交前加三辰，餘為類同陽曆蝕。

translations.literal: If after conjunction subtract two double-hours, before conjunction add three double-hours; the remainder is classified as the same as a yang-calendar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: After conjunction subtract two double-hours and before conjunction add three; the remainder is treated like a yang-half eclipse.

sentences.zh: 又自小滿畢小暑，加時距午正八刻外者，皆減一辰；

translations.literal: Further, from after Grain Full until Minor Heat ends, if the hour-addition's distance from noon proper is outside eight quarter-hours, in each case subtract one double-hour;
translations.idiomatic: From after Grain Full through Minor Heat, if the computed hour lies more than eight quarters from noon, subtract one double-hour;

sentences.zh: 三刻內者，皆加一辰。

translations.literal: if within three quarter-hours, in each case add one double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: if within three quarters of noon, add one double-hour.

sentences.zh: 自大寒畢立春，交前五辰外，自大暑畢立冬，交後五辰外，又減一辰。

translations.literal: From after Great Cold until Start of Spring ends, outside five double-hours before conjunction; from after Great Heat until Start of Winter ends, outside five double-hours after conjunction—again subtract one double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: From after Great Cold through Start of Spring, beyond five double-hours before conjunction, and from after Great Heat through Start of Winter, beyond five double-hours after conjunction, subtract another double-hour.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，既。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, it is total.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder cannot be reduced further, the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 加、減訖，各如定法而一，以減十五，餘為蝕分。

translations.literal: When additions and subtractions are finished, in each case divide by the fixed method and take one; subtract from fifteen; the remainder is the eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: After all adjustments, divide each by the fixed divisor, subtract from fifteen, and the remainder is the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 其陽曆蝕者，置去交分，以蝕差加之。

translations.literal: For yang-calendar eclipses, set the distance-from-conjunction parts and add the eclipse discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: For yang-half eclipses, set the distance from conjunction and add the eclipse correction.

sentences.zh: 交前加一辰，交後減一辰。

translations.literal: Before conjunction add one double-hour, after conjunction subtract one double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Add one double-hour before conjunction and subtract one after.

sentences.zh: 所得，以減望差，餘如百四約之，得為蝕分。

translations.literal: What is obtained, subtract from the full-moon difference; the remainder, reduced by 104, gives the eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the result from the full-moon difference, divide the remainder by 104, and obtain the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 五也。

translations.literal: This is the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fifth point.

sentences.zh: 所蝕分，日以十八乘之，月以二十乘之，皆十五而一，為泛用刻，不復因加。

translations.literal: The eclipse fraction: for the sun multiply by 18, for the moon by 20; in each case divide by 15 to obtain the general-use quarter-hours, without further causal addition.
translations.idiomatic: For the eclipse magnitude, multiply by 18 for solar eclipses and by 20 for lunar, divide each by 15 to get the provisional quarter-hours, with no further additive steps.

sentences.zh: 六也。

translations.literal: This is the sixth.
translations.idiomatic: This is the sixth point.

sentences.zh: 日蝕定用刻在辰正前者，以十分之四為虧初刻，六為復末刻。

translations.literal: For solar eclipse fixed-use quarter-hours before the chen hour proper, take four-tenths as the initial obscuration quarter-hours and six as the final restoration quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed solar-eclipse quarters fall before the chen hour, assign four-tenths to initial obscuration and six-tenths to final restoration.

sentences.zh: 未正後者，六為虧初刻，四為復末刻。

translations.literal: If after wei hour proper, six as initial obscuration quarter-hours and four as final restoration quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: If after the wei hour, assign six-tenths to initial obscuration and four-tenths to final restoration.

sentences.zh: 不復相半。

translations.literal: No longer halving each other.
translations.idiomatic: The halves are no longer split evenly.

sentences.zh: 七也。

translations.literal: This is the seventh.
translations.idiomatic: This is the seventh point.

sentences.zh: 五星乘數、除數，諸變皆通用之，不復變行異數。

translations.literal: The five planets' multipliers and divisors and all mutations universally use these, no longer varying motion with different numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Multipliers, divisors, and all planetary mutations use common values throughout, without separate numbers for each motion phase.

sentences.zh: 入進退曆，皆用度中率。

translations.literal: Entering advance-retreat calendars, all use the mean-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: On entering advance or retreat cycles, all phases use the mean-degree rate.

sentences.zh: 八也。

translations.literal: This is the eighth.
translations.idiomatic: This is the eighth point.

sentences.zh: 以定合初日與前疾初日、後疾初日與合前伏初日先後定數，各同名者，相消為差；

translations.literal: Using the fixed conjunction's first day with the first day of prior fast motion, and the first day of later fast motion with the first day of pre-conjunction hiding—their prior-later fixed numbers: where names are the same, cancel each other as difference;
translations.idiomatic: Compare the fixed offsets of conjunction day with the start of prior fast motion, and of later fast motion with pre-conjunction hiding: where the designations match, cancel to obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 異名者，相從為並。

translations.literal: where names differ, follow each other as sum.
translations.idiomatic: where they differ, combine as a sum.

sentences.zh: 皆四而一。

translations.literal: In each case divide by four and take one.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each result by four.

sentences.zh: 所得滿辰法，各為日。

translations.literal: What is obtained, when it fills the double-hour method, in each case becomes days.
translations.idiomatic: When the quotient fills the double-hour divisor, convert to days.

sentences.zh: 乃以前日盈減、縮加其合後伏日變率，亦以後日盈加、縮減合前伏日變率。

translations.literal: Then with the prior day's surplus subtract and deficit add its post-conjunction hiding-day mutation rate; likewise with the later day's surplus add and deficit subtract the pre-conjunction hiding-day mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract surplus and add deficit from the prior day to the post-conjunction hiding-day rate, and add surplus and subtract deficit from the later day to the pre-conjunction hiding-day rate.

sentences.zh: 太白、辰星夕變，則返加減留退。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury evening mutations, then inversely add and subtract for station and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in evening phase, reverse the additions and subtractions for station and retrograde.

sentences.zh: 二退度變率，若差於中率者，倍所差之數，曰伏差，以加減前疾日度變率。

translations.literal: For the two retreat-degree mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, double the difference number, called hiding discrepancy, to add and subtract the prior fast day's degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the two retrograde-degree rates differ from the mean, double the difference—called hiding discrepancy—and apply it to the prior fast-motion daily degree rate.

sentences.zh: 熒惑均加減前疾兩變日度變率。

translations.literal: Mars uniformly adds and subtracts the prior fast's two-mutation daily degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Mars applies the adjustment equally to both prior fast-motion daily degree rates.

sentences.zh: 歲星、熒惑、鎮星前留日變率，若差於中率者，以所差之數為度，加減前遲日變率。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn prior station-day mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, take the difference number as degrees to add and subtract the prior slow day's mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, if the prior station-day rate differs from the mean, use the difference in degrees to adjust the prior slow-motion daily rate.

sentences.zh: 皆多於中率之數者，加之；

translations.literal: In each case where the number exceeds the mean rate, add;
translations.idiomatic: If the value exceeds the mean rate, add;

sentences.zh: 少於中率者，減之。

translations.literal: where it is less than the mean rate, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: if it is less, subtract.

sentences.zh: 後留日變率，若差於中率者，以所差之數為日，以加減後遲日變率及加減二退度變率。

translations.literal: For later station-day mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, take the difference number as days to add and subtract the later slow day's mutation rate and to add and subtract the two retreat-degree mutation rates.
translations.idiomatic: If the later station-day rate differs from the mean, use the difference in days to adjust the later slow-motion rate and both retrograde-degree rates.

sentences.zh: 又以伏差加減後疾日度變率。

translations.literal: Further use hiding discrepancy to add and subtract the later fast day's degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Also apply hiding discrepancy to the later fast-motion daily degree rate.

sentences.zh: 多於中率之數者，減之；

translations.literal: Where the number exceeds the mean rate, subtract;
translations.idiomatic: If the value exceeds the mean rate, subtract;

sentences.zh: 少於中率者，加之。

translations.literal: where it is less than the mean rate, add.
translations.idiomatic: if it is less, add.

sentences.zh: 其熒惑均加減疾遲兩變日度變率。

translations.literal: For Mars, uniformly add and subtract the fast and slow two-mutation daily degree mutation rates.
translations.idiomatic: Mars applies the same adjustment to both fast- and slow-motion daily degree rates.

sentences.zh: 歲星、鎮星無遲，即加減前後順行日度變率。

translations.literal: Jupiter and Saturn have no slow phase; then add and subtract the prior and later direct-motion daily degree mutation rates.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter and Saturn have no slow phase, so adjust the prior and later direct-motion daily degree rates instead.

sentences.zh: 太白晨夕退行度變率，若差於中率者，亦倍所差之數為度，加減本疾度變率。

translations.literal: For Venus morning and evening retreat-motion degree mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, likewise double the difference number as degrees to add and subtract the base fast degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus morning and evening retrograde-degree rates that differ from the mean, likewise double the difference in degrees and adjust the base fast-motion degree rate.

sentences.zh: 夕合前、後伏，雖亦退行，不取加、 減。

translations.literal: Evening conjunction before and after hiding, though also in retreat motion, do not take add and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For evening conjunction before and after hiding, even during retrograde, do not apply these adjustments.

sentences.zh: 二留日變率，若差於中率者，以所差之數為度，加減本遲度變率。

translations.literal: For the two station-day mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, take the difference number as degrees to add and subtract the base slow degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If either station-day rate differs from the mean, use the difference in degrees to adjust the base slow-motion degree rate.

sentences.zh: 皆多於中率之數加之，少於中率減之。

translations.literal: In each case where the number exceeds the mean rate add; where less than the mean rate subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add when above the mean rate and subtract when below.

sentences.zh: 其辰星二留日變率，若差於中率者，以所差之數為度，各加、減本遲度變率。

translations.literal: For Mercury's two station-day mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, take the difference number as degrees, in each case add and subtract the base slow degree mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury's two station-day rates, if they differ from the mean, use the difference in degrees to adjust each base slow-motion degree rate.

sentences.zh: 疾行度變率，若差於中率者，以所差之數為日，各加、減留日變率。

translations.literal: For fast-motion degree mutation rates, if they differ from the mean rate, take the difference number as days, in each case add and subtract the station-day mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If a fast-motion degree rate differs from the mean, use the difference in days to adjust each station-day rate.

sentences.zh: 亦多於中率之數者，加之；

translations.literal: Likewise where the number exceeds the mean rate, add;
translations.idiomatic: Again, add when above the mean;

sentences.zh: 少於中率者，減之。

translations.literal: where less than the mean rate, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: subtract when below.

sentences.zh: 其留日變率，若少不足減者，侵減遲日變率。

translations.literal: For station-day mutation rates, if too little to subtract, encroach and subtract from the slow-day mutation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the station-day rate is too small to subtract from, reduce the slow-motion daily rate instead.

sentences.zh: 加減訖，皆為日度定率。

translations.literal: When additions and subtractions are finished, all become daily-degree fixed rates.
translations.idiomatic: After all adjustments, the results are the fixed daily-degree rates.

sentences.zh: 九也。

translations.literal: This is the ninth.
translations.idiomatic: This is the ninth point.

sentences.zh: 《大衍》以四象考五星進退，或時弗葉。

translations.literal: The Dayan used the four images to examine the five planets' advance and retreat, but at times it did not accord.
translations.idiomatic: The Dayan judged the five planets' advance and retreat by the four images, but at times the results failed to match observation.

sentences.zh: 獻之加減頗異，而偶與天合。

translations.literal: Xianzhi's additions and subtractions were quite different, yet occasionally accorded with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhi's adjustments differed considerably, yet sometimes matched the heavens.

sentences.zh: 於是頒用，訖建中四年。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was promulgated for use, until the fourth year of Jianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: It was then promulgated and remained in use until the fourth year of Jianzhong.

sentences.zh: 寶應五紀曆

translations.literal: Baoying Wuji Calendar
translations.idiomatic: Baoying Wuji Calendar

sentences.zh: 《寶應五紀曆》演紀上元甲子，距寶應元年壬寅，積二十六萬九千九百七十八算。

translations.literal: The Baoying Wuji Calendar evolving-era computation: the high origin in year jiazi; counting back from the first year of Baoying, year renyin, the accumulated count is 269,978.
translations.idiomatic: In computing the evolving era of the Baoying Wuji Calendar, the high origin falls in the year jiazi; reckoned back from the first year of Baoying (renyin), the accumulated count is 269,978.

sentences.zh: 《五紀》通法千三百四十。

translations.literal: Wuji universal method: 1,340.
translations.idiomatic: Wuji universal divisor: 1,340.

sentences.zh: 策實四十八萬九千四百二十八。

translations.literal: Stalk solid: 489,428.
translations.idiomatic: Year-fraction constant: 489,428.

sentences.zh: 揲法三萬九千五百七十一。

translations.literal: Stalk-divination method: 39,571.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon constant: 39,571.

translations.literal: Stalk remainder: 7,028.
translations.idiomatic: Stalk remainder: 7,028.

sentences.zh: 用差七千五百四十八。

translations.idiomatic: Applied difference: 7,548.

sentences.zh: 掛限三萬八千三百五十七。

translations.literal: Suspended limit: 38,357.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation threshold: 38,357.

sentences.zh: 三元之策十五，餘二百九十二，秒五；

translations.literal: Three-origin interval: 15 stalks, remainder 292, 5 parts;
translations.idiomatic: Three-origin interval: 15 stalks, remainder 292, 5 parts;

sentences.zh: 秒母六。

translations.literal: parts mother 6.
translations.idiomatic: part denominator 6.

sentences.zh: 以象統為母者，以四因之。

translations.literal: Where the image cycle serves as mother, multiply by four.
translations.idiomatic: Where the image cycle is the denominator, multiply by four.

sentences.zh: 四象之策二十九，餘七百一十一。

translations.literal: Four-image interval: 29 stalks, remainder 711.
translations.idiomatic: Four-image interval: 29 stalks, remainder 711.

sentences.zh: 一象之策七，餘五百一十二太。

translations.literal: One-image interval: 7 stalks, remainder 512 and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Single-image interval: 7 stalks, remainder 512 plus.

translations.idiomatic: On the first day of Cold Dew, 23 days for 23°.

sentences.zh: 自後六日損一，畢小雪。

translations.literal: From then on, every six days subtract one, through Minor Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, subtract 1 every 6 days through Minor Snow.

sentences.zh: 夕遲：差行。

translations.literal: Evening slow: differential motion.
translations.idiomatic: Evening slow motion: differential motion.

sentences.zh: 四十二日行三十度。

translations.literal: Forty-two days travel thirty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: 42 days for 30°.

sentences.zh: 先疾，日益遲十三分。

translations.literal: First fast; daily slowness increases thirteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: Fast at first; slowness increases by 13 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 前加度過二百六度者，准數損此度。

translations.literal: If prior added degrees exceed two hundred six degrees, by the amount diminish this degree.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior phase added degrees beyond 206°, subtract that excess from this degree count.

sentences.zh: 夕留：七日。

translations.literal: Evening station: seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Evening station: 7 days.

sentences.zh: 夕退：十日，退五度。

translations.literal: Evening retrograde: ten days, retreats five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Evening retrograde: 10 days, retreats 5°.

sentences.zh: 日盡而夕伏。

translations.literal: Days exhausted and evening occultation.
translations.idiomatic: When its days are exhausted it disappears at evening.

sentences.zh: 晨退：十日，退五度。

translations.literal: Morning retrograde: ten days, retreats five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Morning retrograde: 10 days, retreats 5°.

sentences.zh: 晨留：七日。

translations.literal: Morning station: seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Morning station: 7 days.

sentences.zh: 晨遲：差行。

translations.literal: Morning slow: differential motion.
translations.idiomatic: Morning slow motion: differential motion.

sentences.zh: 冬至畢立夏，大雪畢氣末，四十二日行三十度；

translations.literal: Winter Solstice through Start of Summer, Major Snow through end of qi, forty-two days travel thirty degrees;
translations.idiomatic: From the Winter Solstice through the Start of Summer, and from Major Snow through the end of the qi, 42 days for 30°;

sentences.zh: 先遲，日益疾十三分。

translations.literal: First slow; daily speed increases thirteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: Slow at first; speed increases by 13 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 自小滿後，率十日損一度，畢芒種。

translations.literal: From Minor Fullness afterward, every ten days subtract one degree, through Grain in Ear.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness onward, subtract 1 degree every 10 days through Grain in Ear.

sentences.zh: 夏至畢寒露，四十二日行二十七度；

translations.literal: Summer Solstice through Cold Dew, forty-two days travel twenty-seven degrees;
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice through Cold Dew, 42 days for 27°;

sentences.zh: 差依前。

translations.literal: Differential follows the prior.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the differential as before.

sentences.zh: 自入霜降後，每氣益一度，畢小雪。

translations.literal: From entering Frost's Descent afterward, each qi add one degree, through Minor Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost's Descent onward, add 1 degree per solar term through Minor Snow.

sentences.zh: 晨平行：冬至畢氣末，立夏畢氣末，十三日行十三度。

translations.literal: Morning uniform motion: Winter Solstice through end of qi, Start of Summer through end of qi, thirteen days travel thirteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Morning uniform motion: from the Winter Solstice through the end of the qi, and from the Start of Summer through the end of the qi, 13 days for 13°.

sentences.zh: 自小寒後，六日益日度各一，畢雨水。

translations.literal: From Minor Cold afterward, every six days add days and degrees one each, through Rain Water.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold onward, add 1 each to the day-count and degree-count every 6 days through Rain Water.

sentences.zh: 入小滿後，七日損日度各一，畢立秋。

translations.literal: After entering Minor Fullness, every seven days subtract days and degrees one each, through Start of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness onward, subtract 1 each from the day-count and degree-count every 7 days through the Start of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 驚蟄初日，二十三日行二十三度。

translations.literal: Awakening of Insects first day, twenty-three days travel twenty-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of Awakening of Insects, 23 days for 23°.

sentences.zh: 自後六日損日度各一，畢穀雨。

translations.literal: From then on, every six days subtract days and degrees one each, through Grain Rain.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, subtract 1 each from the day-count and degree-count every 6 days through Grain Rain.

sentences.zh: 處暑畢寒露，無此平行。

translations.literal: End of Heat through Cold Dew, no such uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Cold Dew: no such uniform motion.

sentences.zh: 自入霜降後，五日益日度各一，畢大雪。

translations.literal: From entering Frost's Descent afterward, every five days add days and degrees one each, through Major Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost's Descent onward, add 1 each to the day-count and degree-count every 5 days through Major Snow.

sentences.zh: 晨疾：百七十二日，行二百六度。

translations.literal: Morning fast: one hundred seventy-two days, travels two hundred six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Morning fast motion: 172 days for 206°.

sentences.zh: 前遲行損度不滿三十者，此疾依數益之。

translations.literal: If prior slow motion diminished degrees not reaching thirty, this fast according to the number increase it.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior slow phase diminished degrees by less than 30, add that amount in this fast phase.

sentences.zh: 處暑畢寒露，差行；

translations.literal: End of Heat through Cold Dew, differential motion;
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Cold Dew: differential motion;

sentences.zh: 先遲，日益疾二分。

translations.literal: First slow; daily speed increases two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Slow at first; speed increases by 2 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 自余平行。

translations.literal: From the remainder, uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder follows uniform motion.

sentences.zh: 日盡而晨伏。

translations.literal: Days exhausted and morning occultation.
translations.idiomatic: When its days are exhausted it disappears at morning.

sentences.zh: 夕見疾：十二日，行二十一度十分。

translations.literal: Evening appearance fast: twelve days, travels twenty-one degrees ten parts.
translations.idiomatic: Evening appearance fast motion: 12 days for 21°10 parts.

sentences.zh: 大暑畢處暑，十二日，行十七度十六分。

translations.literal: Major Heat through End of Heat, twelve days, travels seventeen degrees sixteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Heat through End of Heat, 12 days for 17°16 parts.

sentences.zh: 夕平：七日，行七度。

translations.literal: Evening uniform: seven days, travels seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Evening uniform motion: 7 days for 7°.

sentences.zh: 自入大暑後，二日損度各一。

translations.literal: From entering Major Heat afterward, every two days subtract degrees one each.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Heat onward, subtract 1 from the degree-count every 2 days.

sentences.zh: 入立秋，無此平行。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Autumn, no such uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Start of Autumn, omit this uniform-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 夕遲：六日，行二度七分。

translations.literal: Evening slow: six days, travels two degrees seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Evening slow motion: 6 days for 2°7 parts.

sentences.zh: 前疾行十七度者，無此遲行。

translations.literal: If prior fast traveled seventeen degrees, no such slow motion.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior fast phase traveled 17 degrees, omit this slow-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 夕伏留：五日。

translations.literal: Evening occultation station: five days.
translations.idiomatic: Station at evening occultation: 5 days.

sentences.zh: 日盡而夕伏。

translations.literal: Days exhausted and evening occultation.
translations.idiomatic: When its days are exhausted it disappears at evening.

sentences.zh: 晨見留：五日。

translations.literal: Morning appearance station: five days.
translations.idiomatic: Morning appearance station: 5 days.

sentences.zh: 晨遲：六日，行二度七分。

translations.literal: Morning slow: six days, travels two degrees seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Morning slow motion: 6 days for 2°7 parts.

sentences.zh: 自入大寒，畢雨水，無此遲行。

translations.literal: From entering Major Cold through Rain Water, no such slow motion.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold through Rain Water, omit this slow-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 晨平行：七日，行七度。

translations.literal: Morning uniform motion: seven days, travels seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Morning uniform motion: 7 days for 7°.

sentences.zh: 入大寒後，二日損日度各一。

translations.literal: After entering Major Cold, every two days subtract days and degrees one each.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold onward, subtract 1 each from the day-count and degree-count every 2 days.

sentences.zh: 入立春，無此平行。

translations.literal: Entering Start of Spring, no such uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Start of Spring, omit this uniform-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 晨疾；

translations.literal: Morning fast;
translations.idiomatic: Morning fast motion;

sentences.zh: 十二日，行二十一度十分。

translations.literal: Twelve days, travels twenty-one degrees ten parts.
translations.idiomatic: 12 days for 21°10 parts.

sentences.zh: 前無遲行者，十二日，行十七度十六分。

translations.literal: If prior there was no slow motion, twelve days, travels seventeen degrees sixteen parts.
translations.idiomatic: If there was no prior slow phase, 12 days for 17°16 parts.

sentences.zh: 日盡而晨伏。

translations.literal: Days exhausted and morning occultation.
translations.idiomatic: When its days are exhausted it disappears at morning.
